analytic_check.interpretation: Distinct admissible monotone trajectories share endpoint measurements. Endpoint fit alone cannot identify a unique dynamic mechanism.

reason: Metadata has multi-time labels, some pooled strings (3, 6, 12, 24, 48; 72, 96), so this resource must not be dismissed as purely single-time. However cells are destructive snapshots; pooled time labels cannot be converted to individual exact times, and no independently verified pair of competing mechanism models or intervention-specific mechanistic truth has been established. No biological dynamic identification experiment is claimed.
